info.title: Sphaira
info.author: NaGaa95, ITotalJustice
info.description: A feature-rich homebrew menu for Nintendo Switch.
info.details:
Sphaira is a modern Nintendo Switch homebrew menu and file-management environment.

It includes a homebrew launcher, file browser, game and application management, install support, MTP and FTP functionality, App Store integration, forwarder creation, theme support, and a wide range of utility features.

This package installs Sphaira to `sd:/switch/sphaira/sphaira.nro`.

# Sphaira 1.0.8

Added Ownfoil support. ([#379](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/379), @a1ex4)
Added an album menu with QR-code web sharing. ([#377](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/377), @Insektaure)
Added 32-bit address-space options to forwarder. ([#375](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/375), @danfromtico)
Changed game controls: A views content; Y launches with confirmation.
Improved Chinese and Russian translations. ([#373](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/373), @R-YaTian; [#380](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/380), @AlgorithmLX)
